title: Balance the load, stop the sway
lines: Lifting a load? Weight is only half the story.
A swinging load keeps shifting its center of gravity.
Every swing puts a sudden strain on the cable and boom.
Rig by the load's true center of mass.
Use a tag line, and stay clear of the load.
Strong wind? Stop the lift right away.
Tal's daily tip. Ofek At Tal Cranes.
